title: HB2196 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to large-capacity magazines.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-30; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2907844)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2024-01-30); effective July 1, 2024. Bill is a House/Senate twin on one document.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-13 section): (b)(1) Except as provided in subdivision (b)(2), it is an offense for a person to possess a large-capacity magazine, regardless of the date on which the magazine was acquired.
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-13 section): (b)(3) An offense under this subsection (b) is a Class B misdemeanor.
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-13 section): (c)(1) Except as provided in subdivision (c)(2), it is an offense for a person to manufacture or cause to be manufactured, import, keep for sale, or offer or expose for sale, or to give, lend, buy, or receive a large-capacity magazine.
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-13 section): (c)(3) An offense under this subsection (c) is a Class A misdemeanor.
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-13 section): (a)(1) "Large-capacity magazine" means an ammunition feeding device with capacity to accept more than ten (10) rounds; and
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-13 section): (d) A person who is not lawfully authorized to possess a large-capacity magazine pursuant to subsections (b) and (c) shall: (1) Remove the large-capacity magazine from this state; (2) Sell the large-capacity magazine to a licensed firearms dealer; or (3) Surrender the large-capacity magazine to a law enforcement agency for destruction.
